## Checklist

If you wrote or edited an objective page:

- [ ] Sections follow the linux1st.com page order
- [ ] Config samples and command output are included in full, not summarised
- [ ] Hard options have a real world example, not just a definition
- [ ] Long or abstract sections have an ASCII diagram
- [ ] Summary is prose, first person, key terms in backticks
- [ ] No em dashes
- [ ] Front matter `weight` matches `objectives.py`
- [ ] `status:` changed from `stub` to `written`
- [ ] Written in my own words, not pasted from copyrighted material

Ran locally:

- [ ] `mkdocs build --strict` passes
- [ ] `python3 tools/check_style.py` passes
